description: A progress bar — a track with a fill that reports completion, or an animated indeterminate state when the ratio is unknown. `intent` picks the fill colour (primary/secondary/danger), matching the Figma set; the track stays neutral in every intent.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the consumer's own element instead of the native `<div>`, merging
the ARIA and `data-*` hooks onto it via {@link Slot }.

props.name: getValueLabel
props.description:
Produces the human-readable `aria-valuetext`. Receives the resolved
`value` and `max`. Defaults to a rounded percentage (e.g. `"42%"`).
Not called while indeterminate.

props.name: max
props.description:
Upper bound of `value`. Must be a positive, finite number, or Root throws
during render.

props.name: value
props.description:
Current progress, between `0` and `max`. Pass `null` (or omit) for an
indeterminate progress bar whose completion ratio is unknown. Drives the
resolved {@link ProgressState} and the `aria-valuenow` / `data-value`
hooks. A non-`null` value outside `0..max` throws.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Track height; `data-density` scales each size further.

contractProps.name: intent
contractProps.description: Fill colour, matching Figma's `Intent` axis. The track is neutral in every intent — only the fill changes.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.when: the current `value` — readable from CSS without a custom property

dataAttributes.name: data-max
dataAttributes.when: the `max` the value is measured against
